Contract Generator.contract:
Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::createLoanAccount(loanaccountid:Integer,balance:Real,status:LoanAccountStatus[NORMAL|HASPAIDINFULL]): Boolean {
          definition:
          loanAccount:LoanAccount = LoanAccount.allInstance()->any(o | o.LoanAccountID = loanaccountid)
            
            precondition:
          loanAccount.oclIsUndefined() = true or loanAccount.oclIsUndefined() = false
            
            postcondition:
          (loanAccount.oclIsNew() and loanAccount.LoanAccountID = loanaccountid and loanAccount.Balance = balance and loanAccount.Status = status and LoanAccount.allInstance()->includes(loanAccount)) or (loanAccount.oclIsNew() = false) and result = true
            
        }
